query:
UPDATE refresh_tokens
           SET revoked_at = now(), revoked_reason = $1
           WHERE user_id = $2
             AND revoked_at IS NULL
             AND family_id IN (
                 SELECT family_id FROM refresh_tokens
                 WHERE user_id = $2
                   AND revoked_at IS NULL
                   AND used_at IS NULL
                   AND expires_at > now()
                 GROUP BY family_id
                 ORDER BY max(last_used_at) DESC
                 OFFSET $3
             )
